Class AssociateCustomer

java.lang.Object
ict373assignment1q2.Customer
ict373assignment1q2.AssociateCustomer
public class AssociateCustomer extends Customer
Represents an associate customer. An associate customer gets the magazine through a paying customer and does not pay for their own subscription.
